description: Is a company hiring? A company's hiring profile from its public job board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday), crawled twice a day: careers page, open roles, top departments, locations and countries, remote share, pay median, newest jobs, and jobs opened and closed in the last 7 and 30 days from our crawl history. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
